info.name: SPMT - INT Integration API (Site Survey Ingestion)
info.description:
API Integration Specification for INT System pushing Site Survey & Job Execution Reports to SPMT System.

### Authentication
Pass API Key in the Header:
`Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>` or `X-API-Key: <API_KEY>`

### Idempotency
Ensure `X-Idempotency-Key` is passed on all push requests to prevent duplicate processing.
